title: Glow threshold
question: When do crowded Lanterns start to glow?
intervention: Watch the crowded patch in dim light. When a Lantern glows, tap it: the inspector shows the signal it senses, its glow thresholds and its energy.
predictedTradeoff: Glowing costs energy, so Lanterns that glow spend more than dim ones while sugar lasts; a Lantern low on energy stops glowing.
confounds: Signal builds up where Lanterns crowd, so who glows first depends on where each one sits and moves. Glow-on and glow-off counts are counts of records, not of Lanterns: one Lantern can switch more than once. This is one run.

all.label: At least one Lantern started to glow
